title: Apply Pressure = Force / Area

hook.scenario: Aapke paas ek 5 kg ki eent (brick) hai. Agar aap isko sidha khada karke table pe rakhte hain to ek nishaan padd jata hai, lekin flat rakhne par nahi.
hook.question: Formula se kaise saabit (prove) karein ki same eent ka asar uski position par depend karta hai?

mental_model.intuition: Formula as a balancer: Upar rakho force (weight) aur usko divide kar do area se.
mental_model.description: Pressure = Force / Area. Numerator mein force (Newton) hai aur denominator mein area (meter²). Ek object apna alag-alag area zameen pe dikha sakta hai, isliye uska P bhi badalta rahega, jabki F (uske weight) same hai.

explanation:
Pressure ka formula P = F / A, numericals solve karne ka main tool hai. Yahan 'F' thrust ya force hai jo perpendicular direction mein lag raha hai, aur 'A' woh area hai jo surface ke contact mein hai.

Problem solve karte waqt do cheezon ka dhyan sabse zyada rakhna padta hai. Pehli, unit conversion. Bahut baar area cm² ya mm² mein diya hota hai. Pascal (Pa) use karne ke liye aapko Area hamesha m² (square meters) mein convert karna hoga. (Yaad rakhein 1 cm² = 10^-4 m²).

Doosri baat F (force) nikalna. Kai baar F direct nahi diya hota, balki object ka mass diya hota hai. Aise cases mein force uska weight hota hai, isliye hum pehle W = m × g se F nikalte hain. Uske baad area se divide karke pressure calculate karte hain.

Jaise ek wooden block (dimensions 20×10×5 cm) table par rakha ho. Agar aap use uske 20×10 wale face par rakhenge toh area sabse bada hoga aur pressure sabse kam. Agar 10×5 wale face par rakhenge toh area sabse chhota hoga aur pressure sabse zyada.

key_points.title: Area Conversion is MUST
key_points.detail: Always convert cm or mm to meters before calculating area, or properly adjust the final area unit.

key_points.title: Force is Weight
key_points.detail: Do not divide mass directly. First convert mass to force (weight) by multiplying by acceleration due to gravity (9.8 m/s²).

worked_example.problem: A block of mass 5 kg and dimensions 20 cm x 10 cm x 5 cm is placed on a table with its 20 cm x 10 cm face in contact with the table. Find the pressure exerted on the table. (Take g = 9.8 m/s^2)

steps.narration: Pehle thrust ya force nikalenge W = m * g lagakar.
Ab area of contact calculate karte hain jo 20 cm x 10 cm hai. Ise meter mein convert karna hoga.
Ab formula mein rakh kar divide karenge.

worked_example.problem: A woman weighing 500 N stands on one foot. The area of contact of her stiletto heel with the ground is 0.0001 m^2. Calculate the pressure exerted on the ground.

steps.narration: Force seedha diya gaya hai kyunki weight 500 N hai.
Area pehle se hi square meters mein hai.

common_mistakes.title: Forgetting to square the conversion factor
common_mistakes.explanation: Bache 100 cm = 1 m jante hain, aur wo cm² ko meter² banate waqt sirf 100 se divide karte hain. Actually unhe 100 × 100 yani 10000 se divide karna hota hai.

recall_questions.q: If a force of 100 N is applied over an area of 2 m², what is the pressure?
What happens to pressure if the force is doubled over the same area?
Why do school bags have wide straps?
recall_questions.answer: To increase the area and reduce the pressure on shoulders.

oa_questions.question: A girl of mass 40 kg stands on one foot. The area of her foot is 100 cm^2. What is the pressure she exerts on the ground? (g = 10 m/s^2)
Calculate the pressure if a force of 100 N acts on an area of 2 m².
